_comment: TEMPLATE. Files starting with an underscore are ignored by the pipeline. Copy this to a real name like az.json, delete the _comment lines, and fill it in. Run `npm run scrape:one curated-benefits` to check your work: any mistake is reported by field name and nothing broken gets published.
_id: Permanent. It becomes part of the page URL. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens.
_jurisdiction: Two-letter code. See data/jurisdictions.json for all 56.
_category: One of: property-tax, income-tax, education, employment, health, recreation, vehicle, housing, burial, financial, legal, license-fee, family, business, other.
title: Disabled Veteran property tax exemption
summary: A short, plain-language description. Two sentences at most. Write it for a Veteran reading on a phone, not for a caseworker.
amount: Up to $4,748 of assessed value, as of 2026
_amount: Optional. Copy the figure and the year from the official page. Never estimate.
eligibility: Copy the substance from the official page rather than paraphrasing loosely
details: Optional longer paragraphs. Plain text only, never HTML.
_officialUrl: REQUIRED. The government page you read to write this. Not a search result, not a blog, not another directory.
_confidence: Only write 'verified' if you personally opened officialUrl and confirmed every claim above. If you are working from memory or a secondhand source, use 'needs-review' instead. A wrong benefit figure can cost a Veteran a filing deadline.
